Thrilled to share the results of our four-day work week pilot! Over the course of 12 weeks, we took a bold step forward, bringing together 46 dedicated employees from our Denver office to explore a more flexible way of working.

Key highlights include:

- **Productivity held steady:** Output per person remained flat throughout the pilot, showing that teams maintained their performance on a compressed schedule.
- **Wellness improved:** Sick days dropped from 61 to 38, a meaningful reduction that reflects healthier, more rested teams.
- **Strong employee support:** An impressive 41 of 46 participants (roughly 89%) asked to keep the four-day schedule going forward.

These results point to a promising path for balancing employee well-being with business performance. We're excited to explore how this model can continue to empower our people and help us build an even stronger, more resilient workplace together!
